summary: Three changes in one pull request. (1) pmdoc/token.go: one token encoder for every caller, appending the token representation once into a per-call buffer with hand-written appenders byte-identical to encoding/json (json.Marshal fallback for any other type), recording each block-id node's span in pre-order; docs.documentTokens hashes the whole buffer (document token) and each span (block tokens, pre-order last-wins); renderedBlocks returns the document token so buildDocumentRead stops re-encoding; checkEditPrecondition uses one pass; WriteTokenJSON/tokenWriter deleted; error parity by a per-block fallback only when the one pass errors. (2) TableDescendantIDs uses Walk (no positions). (3) yattrToMarkName without its regexp (R10, -22..26% of treeOf measured); the fold keeps pmdoc.Read's attribute copy.

decisions: One encoder for every token caller; the streaming WriteTokenJSON is deleted, since a second encoder could drift from the first and refuse every edit precondition.
Per-call buffer, no pool and no package-level buffer, so nothing stays resident; AGENTS.md:384-385 and the two comments are rewritten.

R10 is fixed in this pull request by the regexp-free yattrToMarkName; the fold keeps pmdoc.Read's attribute copy, because skipping it (about 8% of treeOf, 0.0004 cores) would make LoadDocument's fresh document an ownership contract INFRA-514's children may change, against packages/envoy/AGENTS.md:554.
Load-test inputs: --events 0 and --sessions 1000 so every seeded spec is read and folds on a cold read cache with no resident rooms and no commit-lock saturation.
